footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Lifecore Biomedical: after $5.6M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended May 25, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 0.5% to $129M in fiscal 2025 (ended May 25, 2025). Gross margin was 31.3%, versus 32.6% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $17.2M from $8.8M.
The company had a net loss of $44.4M, or −$1.27 per share, versus net income of $12.0M. Operating cash flow was −$206K and free cash flow −$13.6M, versus −$18.1M.
sources: Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
